newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp's Reed sees emerging market growth.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp's Reed sees emerging market growth.

text.p: Citicorp Chairman John Reed said Thursday emerging markets are growing faster than the more mature economies of industrialized nations.
"Emerging markets are growing substantially more rapidly than" Japan, Europe and North America, he told reporters after speaking at a banking conference.

"The Middle East is doing well ... Africa is doing much better than it has been," Reed said adding that the emergence of South Africa has had a "very positive" impact. Asia-Pacific is "slowing down a little bit" and Korea is "stumbling a bit" because of its competitive situation with Japan, he said.
In Latin America, Brazil and Argentina are doing "very well," Reed added.
Separately, asked whether the Federal Reserve should raise interest rates, Reed replied: "My personal view is they don't need to."
Asked whether a rate increase would adversely affect the banking industry, he said: "no, it's in the market."
